messages:
maya-ux: quick thread  small UX review for the playground: proposing a hover-to-copy + export-to-eval affordance for structured outputs. idea: when you hover a function-call result show a tiny action bar with "Copy JSON" and "Export to Eval". keeps the run list clean but surfaces common actions. thoughts?

eli-devex: +1 to export-to-eval. request: make export opt-in per workspace (to avoid accidentally leaking dev-only data). also need telemetry for clicks.

sam-frontend: implementation notes: action bar should be visually hidden until hover/focus. keyboard support: reveal on row focus, actions tabbable. keep icons 16px and label hidden visually but present to SR with aria-labels.

maya-ux: copy ideas: use full labels for a11y: "Copy JSON for run <id>" and "Export result to Eval suite". visually we can show icons + short tooltip.

rachit-ml: for tool-calls the exported artifact should include schema metadata and model+prompt snapshot. we should warn if the run contains PII and require a confirmation modal. also surface a small badge when schema mismatch was detected.

zoe-qa: QA checklist:
- Hover reveals action bar
- Tab to row shows actions (no mouse)
- Copy writes clean JSON to clipboard (strip internal meta unless opt-in)
- Export opens modal with preview and requires explicit confirm
- SR reads actions and confirmation dialog labels
I can validate with VoiceOver + ChromeVox.

sam-frontend: performance note: avoid large clipboard payloads >1MB. truncate with a message and a download link for big artifacts.

maya-ux: accessibility nit: action bar must have at least 44px target height when focused. use focus-visible outlines. also ensure color contrast for the export button (WCAG AA).

eli-devex: analytics: emit events `ui.playground.copy_json` and `ui.playground.export_eval` with run_id and whether schema_warning=true.

rachit-ml: one more UX point: for collapsed/dense rows we should surface a tiny kebab menu to access these actions since hover area is small on Dense. preserve the same keyboard flow.

deploy-bot: deploy: playground/hover-actions @staging -> success :white_check_mark: (build 2026-03-24.4)

maya-ux: i'll add mocks to the design doc and update the a11y checklist. can folks review before EOD Friday?

eli-devex: i'll review.
